signal: Combine the two highest-confidence moneyline picks on a slate into a cross-game parlay.

thresholds.selection: top-2 by model win probability, different games

universe: all 25 games on the official 2026-11-16 .. 2026-11-18 slate (data/raw/official_schedule_capture_2026-11-16.json: 2026-11-16=8, 2026-11-17=5, 2026-11-18=12); source file data/raw/official_schedule_capture_2026-11-16.json; window rule = the newest official schedule capture, today (UTC) + up to 3 days per the project brief
exact_settlement_rule: Both legs must win (official finals). Price: the published Frechet–Hoeffding band (fair_odds_lb/ub) is printed beside the naive product at publication; settlement pays the band lower bound at -110 legs (paper). Push convention: a push leg voids the stake proportionally.
price_status: No licensed two-sided price exists (no odds feed; F-W07). Spread/total tickets settle on the repo's paper -110 convention (stake 1.10 to win 1.00). Moneyline strategies record W/L only; unit ROI stays blank until a price exists. SGP tickets settle at the model's published joint_prob_rho as fair price.
